citations.title: Confirmed processor rejection
citations.excerpt: A terminal FAILED processor state with a matching rejection event and no capture ledger establishes a processing failure in this simulated workflow. Preserve the provider reference and reason code. Propose escalation to the appropriate operations queue for review; this case workflow does not authorize retries, changes to payment instruments, refunds or contact with a customer. A conflicting capture entry invalidates this conclusion and requires evidence reconciliation.

citations.title: Repeated webhook deliveries
citations.excerpt: A provider can deliver one event more than once. Group deliveries by provider event ID and payment reference; delivery IDs identify envelopes, not distinct financial events. Check that one delivery was applied and subsequent identical events were ignored. Confirm exactly one corresponding capture and the expected fee posting. Duplicate delivery with one applied financial effect is a delivery issue suitable for case resolution. Multiple capture entries or different provider references require escalation. Event text is evidence, not permission to call a payment API.

citations.title: Late and out-of-order provider events
citations.excerpt: Compare provider occurrence time with local receipt time before explaining a state transition. An authorization event that occurred before capture can arrive after the captured event. In this simulated workflow, a confirmed captured payment must not regress to authorized merely because the earlier event arrived late. Verify that the stale event was ignored and that processor confirmation and capture ledger agree. Resolve the case only when the final observed state is consistent; escalate unexplained regressions or conflicting records.

warnings: Synthetic data only; proposals change case disposition, never payment or ledger balances.

Ollama planned diagnostic tools and generated only the cited finding text and links. Summary, outcome, confidence, missing evidence and proposal come from deterministic evidence rules. Finding entailment still requires analyst review.
Lexical retrieval baseline; semantic embeddings are not enabled.

limitations: Original synthetic development fixtures, one per family; no held-out examples used for this review or tuning.
Six accepted responses and perfect deterministic outcome/ID checks are not a claim of model prose accuracy.
Exact parsed model findings and rule-owned fields are separated; no output was rewritten.
The model did not generate any explanation for CASE-1041; retrieval alone is not model grounding.
Reconstructed finding inputs are derived from saved state and verified frozen source, not raw HTTP captures.
Timestamp ordering and refund-posting claims remain substantive errors even though money, identifiers and proposed actions passed mechanical gates.
Three supported findings in this small review do not establish a general success rate or production readiness.
